"""Independent stdlib verification of retained v0.3 artifact bytes and causal scope."""
import argparse,collections,gzip,hashlib,io,json,pathlib,re,zipfile
from decimal import Decimal

def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def canonical(v):return json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()
def require(condition,message):
 if not condition:raise ValueError(message)
def sealed(b):
 v=json.loads(b);require(type(v) is dict and v['content_sha256']==sha(canonical({k:x for k,x in v.items() if k!='content_sha256'})),'JSON content hash');return v
def archive(b):
 z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b));names=z.namelist();require(len(names)==len(set(names)),'duplicate ZIP member')
 for item in z.infolist():
  name=pathlib.PurePosixPath(item.filename)
  require(not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and str(name)==item.filename and not item.is_dir() and (item.external_attr>>16)&0o170000!=0o120000,'unsafe ZIP member')
 return {n:z.read(n) for n in names}
def inventory(files,name):
 inv=sealed(files[name]);actual={n:{'sha256':sha(b),'bytes':len(b)} for n,b in files.items() if n!=name}
 require(actual==inv['files'],'complete ZIP inventory')
 for n,b in files.items():
  if n.endswith('.json'):sealed(b)
 return inv,actual

def verify(root,result_zip,github_digest):
 raw=result_zip.read_bytes();require(sha(raw)==github_digest,'GitHub ZIP digest')
 files=archive(raw);inv,hashes=inventory(files,'capture-inventory.json');report=sealed(files['capture-report.json'])
 requests=sealed((root/'research/runtime/sealed-historical-execution-input-plan-v0.1/request-manifest.json').read_bytes())['requests']
 require(len(requests)==90 and sha(canonical(requests))=='4515172de55e48d42f1312b5b298dd2c126fccea700b39417cf600221d76e8ce','original request list')
 selected=requests[25:];require(sha(canonical(selected))=='9f96fe77746cd08fbbb6174bb2bea8baa3529a0cf3d71ab036abbf01aa75acae','exact suffix')
 parent=files['parent-v02-result.zip'];require(sha(parent)=='2065c140c2c14bc7da14a22483934eb1631169a36a599e522e0b59c27d7ff6e9','parent ZIP')
 pf=archive(parent);pi,ph=inventory(pf,'capture-inventory.json')
 audit=sealed((root/'research/data-audits/sealed-historical-execution-input-acquisition-v0.2-independent-verification-34076412463.json').read_bytes())
 require({n:{'sha256':sha(b),'bytes':len(b)} for n,b in pf.items()}==audit['result_zip_verification']['files'],'all 62 immutable parent files')
 pr=sealed(pf['capture-report.json']);require(len(pf)==62 and pr['completed_request_count']==24 and pr['http_attempts']==205 and pr['blocked_attempts']==0 and pr['acquisition_gate_passed'] is False,'parent failure boundary')
 jva=files['jva-empty-diagnostic.zip'];require(sha(jva)=='246ab302c949f22af2907fecba9e024b0c30b6901c91446f4401fab5627e91ea','JVA ZIP')
 jf=archive(jva);ji,jh=inventory(jf,'diagnostic-inventory.json');jr=sealed(jf['diagnostic-report.json'])
 require(len(jf)==17 and jr['content_sha256']=='b7324d1e6f123a2adca163f8d8e609db6a173f200c36a180396b8dad734c7da7','exact JVA report')
 require(jr['native_observation']['native_record_count']==0 and jr['observation']['frame']['row_count']==0 and jr['outcome']['code']=='metadata_only_exact_dbn_empty_before_mapping','JVA unavailable native evidence')
 require(gzip.decompress(jf['native-projection.jsonl.gz'])==gzip.decompress(jf['diagnostic-projection.jsonl.gz'])==b'','full empty projections')
 quoted=sealed(pf['parent-quote-report.json']);md=sealed(files['metadata-http-ledger.json']);td=sealed(files['timeseries-http-ledger.json']);calls=sealed(files['metadata-ledger.json'])['calls']
 require(len(calls)==len(md['attempts'])==md['http_attempts']==130,'complete 130 metadata calls')
 require(len(td['attempts'])==td['http_attempts']==65,'exact 65 downloads')
 for led,forbidden in [(md,'non_metadata_calls'),(td,'unregistered_endpoint_calls')]:
  require(all(led[k]==0 for k in ('blocked_attempts','automatic_retries','redirects_followed',forbidden)),'separate ledger boundaries')
 total_bytes=0;total_cost=Decimal(0)
 for i,r in enumerate(selected):
  for j,method in enumerate(('get_billable_size','get_cost')):
   call=calls[2*i+j];http=md['attempts'][2*i+j]
   identity={'ordinal':2*i+j+1,'request_id':r['request_id'],'method':method}
   require(all(call[k]==v and http[k]==v for k,v in identity.items()),'exact metadata identity')
   require(call['status']=='success' and call['error'] is None and call['request_content_sha256']==sha(canonical(r)) and http['status']=='success' and http['http_status']==200,'metadata success binding')
  size,cost=calls[2*i]['value'],Decimal(calls[2*i+1]['value']);ceiling=quoted['quote_rows'][i+25]
  require(type(size) is int and 0<size<=ceiling['billable_size_bytes'] and Decimal(0)<cost<=Decimal(ceiling['quoted_cost_usd']),'per-request original ceilings')
  total_bytes+=size;total_cost+=cost
 require(total_bytes<=131758640 and total_cost<=Decimal('0.147390693429'),'aggregate original ceilings')
 rq=sealed(files['requote-report.json']);require(rq==report['requote'] and rq['calls']==calls and rq['preflight_passed'] is True and rq['total_billable_bytes']==total_bytes and Decimal(rq['total_quoted_cost_usd'])==total_cost,'requote rebuilt')
 ledger=sealed(files['download-ledger.json']);require(ledger['requests']==report['requests'] and ledger['evidence_complete'] is True,'request ledger')
 rows=report['requests'];require(len(rows)==65,'complete suffix classifications')
 schema_counts=collections.Counter();states=collections.Counter();unavailable=[];tape_hashes={};inherited_rows=0;normalized_bytes=0
 def tape(b,request,info):
  nonlocal normalized_bytes
  data=gzip.decompress(b);normalized_bytes+=len(data)
  require(len(data)==info['normalized_bytes'] and sha(data)==info['normalized_sha256'] and len(b)==info['file_bytes'] and sha(b)==info['file_sha256'],'all tape hashes')
  lines=data.splitlines(keepends=True);require(len(lines)==info['row_count'] and len(lines)>0,'nonempty row count')
  previous=None;schema=request['schema'];symbol=request['symbols'][0];rsha=sha(canonical(request));ties=0
  fields={'symbol','ts_recv_ns','sequence','bid_px_nanos','bid_size','ask_px_nanos','ask_size','source_request_sha256','source_record_index'} if schema=='mbp-1' else {'symbol','ts_recv_ns','action','is_trading'}
  for index,line in enumerate(lines):
   row=json.loads(line);require(canonical(row)+b'\n'==line and set(row)==fields,'normalized canonical fields')
   require(row['symbol']==symbol and type(row['ts_recv_ns']) is int and request['start_ns']<=row['ts_recv_ns']<request['end_ns'],'exact symbol and nanosecond bounds')
   if schema=='mbp-1':
    require(row['source_request_sha256']==rsha and type(row['source_record_index']) is int and row['source_record_index']==index,'original request ordinal')
    require(all(type(row[k]) is int and row[k]>=0 for k in ('sequence','bid_px_nanos','bid_size','ask_px_nanos','ask_size')),'native quote fields')
    key=(row['ts_recv_ns'],row['sequence']);require(previous is None or previous<=key,'native order');ties+=previous==key;previous=key
   else:
    require(type(row['action']) is int and row['action']>=0 and row['is_trading'] in {'Y','N','~'},'native status fields')
    require(previous is None or previous<row['ts_recv_ns'],'status chronology');previous=row['ts_recv_ns']
  return len(lines),ties
 for i,row in enumerate(pr['requests'][:24]):
  count,ties=tape(pf[row['tape']['path']],requests[i],row['tape']);inherited_rows+=count
 require(inherited_rows==73614,'all inherited normalized rows')
 expected={'parent-v02-result.zip','jva-empty-diagnostic.zip','contract.json','execution.json','consumption.json','environment.json','parent-verification.json','metadata-http-ledger.json','timeseries-http-ledger.json','metadata-ledger.json','requote-report.json','download-ledger.json','capture-report.json','capture-inventory.json'}
 for i,row in enumerate(rows):
  r=selected[i];index=i+25;identity={'ordinal':i+1,'original_request_index':index,'request_id':r['request_id'],'request_content_sha256':sha(canonical(r)),'schema':r['schema']}
  require(all(row[k]==v for k,v in identity.items()),'frozen request order and identity')
  require(row['status'] in {'complete','unavailable'} and row['error'] is None and row['failure_stage'] is None and row['partial']==[],'terminal classification')
  states[row['status']]+=1;n=row['native'];sealed(canonical(n));http=td['attempts'][i]
  require(all(http[k]==row[k] for k in ('ordinal','request_id','request_content_sha256')) and http['method']=='timeseries.get_range' and http['status']=='complete' and http['http_status']==200,'complete exact download')
  require(n['request_content_sha256']==identity['request_content_sha256'] and n['decoding_complete'] is True and n['exact_metadata'] is True and 0<n['wire_bytes']==http['wire_bytes']<=http['maximum_wire_bytes']==quoted['quote_rows'][index]['billable_size_bytes']+65536,'native receipt binding')
  receipt=f'receipts/request-{index:03d}.json';expected.add(receipt);rec=sealed(files[receipt]);require(rec['request']==r and rec['completion']==row and rec['raw_dbn_persisted'] is False,'distinct terminal receipt')
  if row['status']=='unavailable':
   require(row['tape'] is None and row['normalization'] is None and n['native_record_count']==0 and n['decoded_v3_record_bytes_sha256']==sha(b'') and row['unavailable']=={'code':'metadata_only_exact_request','native_record_count':0,'normalized_row_count':0,'runtime_input_eligible':False,'resting_quote_or_trading_status_inferred':False},'explicit unavailable input')
   unavailable.append(r['request_id'])
  else:
   name=f'tapes/request-{index:03d}.jsonl.gz';expected.add(name);info=row['tape'];require(info['path']==name and row['unavailable'] is None,'bound nonempty tape')
   count,ties=tape(files[name],r,info);require(count==n['native_record_count']==row['normalization']['row_count'] and ties==row['normalization']['native_key_adjacent_ties'],'native-normalized reconciliation')
   schema_counts[r['schema']]+=count;tape_hashes[name]=info
 require(set(files)==expected,'no extra or missing retained members')
 require(normalized_bytes<=1500000000 and sum(len(b) for b in files.values())<=1000000000,'retention bounds')
 coverage=report['coverage'];require(len(coverage)==90,'all original requests covered')
 for i,row in enumerate(coverage):
  require(row['original_request_index']==i and row['request_id']==requests[i]['request_id'] and row['request_content_sha256']==sha(canonical(requests[i])),'unchanged coverage identity')
  require(row['status']==('inherited_complete' if i<24 else 'inherited_unavailable' if i==24 else rows[i-25]['status']),'coverage outcome')
 require(report['request_evidence_complete'] is True and report['new_complete_count']==states['complete'] and report['new_unavailable_count']==states['unavailable'] and report['new_normalized_row_count']==sum(schema_counts.values()) and report['unattempted_count']==0,'recomputed report counts')
 require(all(report[k] is False for k in ('acquisition_gate_passed','runtime_input_eligible','account_or_fill_simulation_executed','backtesting_executed','retrospective_inputs_loaded','policy_changed','consumed_parent_rerun','raw_dbn_retained','actual_billing_known')),'no downstream gate or authority')
 require(report['original_source_provider_requests']==30522 and report['date_count']==30 and report['opportunity_count']==109 and report['symbol_date_count']==45 and report['http_attempts']==195 and report['blocked_attempts']==0 and report['error'] is None,'source ledger, frozen population, separate ledger')
 return {'zip_sha256':sha(raw),'zip_bytes':len(raw),'file_count':len(files),'embedded_parent_file_count':79,'report_file_sha256':sha(files['capture-report.json']),'report_content_sha256':report['content_sha256'],'inventory_content_sha256':inv['content_sha256'],'all_file_hashes':{n:{'sha256':sha(b),'bytes':len(b)} for n,b in files.items()},'new_tape_hashes':tape_hashes,'new_classifications':dict(states),'new_schema_row_counts':dict(schema_counts),'inherited_rows':inherited_rows,'inherited_complete_tapes':24,'inherited_unavailable_request':'2025-06-13-JVA-mbp-1','new_unavailable_requests':unavailable,'normalized_bytes_including_parent':normalized_bytes,'http_attempts':195,'blocked_attempts':0,'maximum_quoted_cost_usd':str(total_cost),'source_ledger_requests':30522,'source_provider_calls':0,'acquisition_gate_passed':False,'verification_passed':True}

if __name__=='__main__':
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--root',type=pathlib.Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--zip',type=pathlib.Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--github-sha256',required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=pathlib.Path,required=True);args=p.parse_args()
 result=verify(args.root,args.zip,args.github_sha256);args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('all_file_hashes','new_tape_hashes')},sort_keys=True))
